description: Trigger discrimination for the QA conductor (this skill) vs the project journey front door (project-orchestrator), product-wide QA strategy (qa-strategy-architect), a single test plan (test-plan-designer), a security scan (security-scan-orchestrator), and root-cause debugging (systematic-debugger, manual-only).

cases.prompt: I do not know where to start with testing. Help me test my app end to end and tell me what to fix first.
cases.note: PRIMARY — the user wants the QA work chosen and sequenced, not the whole product journey and not one named QA document.
cases.reason: Sequencing a complete QA pass across the fixed plays is the conductor; project-orchestrator routes the product journey, qa-strategy-architect defines product-wide strategy, test-plan-designer writes one plan.

cases.prompt: I want to build and ship a product from my idea — what do I do first?
cases.note: JOURNEY-vs-QA SEAM — no testing goal is stated; the request is the whole lifecycle.
cases.reason: The beginner journey across stages is project-orchestrator; the QA conductor only runs after there is something to test.

cases.prompt: Define our product-wide QA strategy: risk inventory, which layers we automate vs keep manual, and ownership per layer.
cases.note: STRATEGY-vs-PLAY SEAM — product-level rules, not one play.
cases.reason: Product-wide QA strategy is qa-strategy-architect; the conductor chooses and runs a play for a testing goal.

cases.prompt: Write the test plan for the checkout feature only — scope, layers, exit criteria.
cases.note: SCOPED SINGLE SKILL — the user names the artifact they want.
cases.reason: A single feature test plan is test-plan-designer directly; it is play B only when the user needs the play chosen and run.

cases.prompt: Run a whole-repo security scan and give me one aggregated report of SAST, dependency and secret findings.
cases.note: SECURITY SCAN vs QA PASS — static security scanning is a different deliverable.
cases.reason: Whole-repo static security scanning/aggregation is security-scan-orchestrator; QA functional testing is the conductor.

cases.prompt: This bug keeps happening and I need the root cause found and fixed now.
cases.note: ROOT CAUSE (manual-only) — the conductor names and stops.
cases.reason: Driving a bug to root cause is systematic-debugger (manual-only); the conductor only routes blockers there and never runs it.
